title: AccountVerificationSessionUpdateRequest
description: Request body for updating an account verification session.

micro_deposits.description: Micro deposit verification amounts. Required for micro_deposits type.

amounts.description: The micro deposit amounts to verify.

plaid.description: Plaid verification data. Required for plaid type.

balances.description: The raw balance data received from Plaid.

transactions.description: The raw transaction data received from Plaid.

mx.description: MX verification data. Required for mx type.

account.description: The raw account data received from MX.

transactions.description: The raw transaction data received from MX.

teller.description: Teller verification data. Required for teller type.

balances.description: The raw balance data received from Teller.

transactions.description: The raw transaction data received from Teller.

standard.description: Standard verification data. Required for standard type.

pre_auth.description: Pre-auth verification data. Required for pre_auth type.

number.description: The full card number. Required if the number on the session is null.

exp_month.description: The card expiration month. Required if null or exp_check is fail.

exp_year.description: The card expiration year. Required if null or exp_check is fail.

cvv.description: The card CVV. Required if null or cvv_check is fail.

network.description: Network verification data. Required for network type.

number.description: The full card number. Required if the number on the session is null.

exp_month.description: The card expiration month. Required if null or exp_check is fail.

exp_year.description: The card expiration year. Required if null or exp_check is fail.

cvv.description: The card CVV. Required if null or cvv_check is fail.

instant.description: Instant verification data. Required for instant type.

number.description: The full card number. Required if the number on the session is null.

exp_month.description: The card expiration month. Required if null or exp_check is fail.

exp_year.description: The card expiration year. Required if null or exp_check is fail.
